answer_1.quote: Our focus in this work is on knowledge elicitation from PLMs, ... we do not aim to compare with previous dataset‑specific methods ...

answer_2.quote: We report Exact Match (EM) and Answer F1 scores for 2Wiki & R4C, and EM score for LoT ... We also evaluate the ratio where the recalled knowledge contains the answer entity (Ans.R) and evidence coverage (Evi.R).
